grading_notes.swe_environment: Official cached and source-pinned reconstructed containers were accepted only if the reference patch passed and the unchanged base did not. Same grader per A/B pair.
grading_notes.requests_3362: An internal Docker network with a reserved unreachable address reproduced the original connection timeout, with no external connection.
grading_notes.pytest_8365: Both existing runs were exported and scored after omitting only the untracked test temporary directory from the export copy.
grading_notes.unvalidated_requests: A subset of old Requests assertions depends on external HTTP/DNS behavior. The reference patch did not pass in the constrained offline grader.
